title: Q-CRIT-COLLECTORS: push GitHub-run, ops/cost.jsonl and workflow_dispatch samples to /api/criticality/sample and mirror /metrics/criticality.json into ultrastable/seed
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** CRITICALITY-1 merged
**Done check:** grep:deploy/criticality-collect.mjs::criticality/sample
**Status:** closed

code-task: repo=ultrastable/ultrastable path=deploy/criticality-collect.mjs
code-anchor: Q-CRIT-COLLECTORS

The tick computes k_eff from D1 outcomes and criticality_samples. Add a collector that, each deploy-workers run, counts verified deploys/failures (GitHub runs, live_matches_commit rows in ops/deploys.jsonl), reads spend units from ops/cost.jsonl (PR #300), counts workflow_dispatch runs as human_touches, POSTs one sample with the CRITICALITY_TOKEN bearer, and commits the live /metrics/criticality.json to ultrastable/seed metrics/criticality.json. Closing probe: /live shows k_eff non-null and the seed file's `at` is under one tick old.

**Evidence:** closing probe passed (first pass): grep:deploy/criticality-collect.mjs::criticality/sample
